conviction_note: Many small, mostly positive items (Q3 same-store sales guided to roughly flat or positive against a -27.8% comp, an EPS bar that implies margins below Q2's 14.3%, a special dividend declared 18 days before the print with Q3 already closed, a 2026 'broadly flat' guide that the run-rate is tracking above) against a weak sector tape (Mixue at a post-IPO low, October catering +0.7%) give impact_sum +3.0. The scaled number is only +1.12 (p_up 57 x abs 8) because the EPS bar is disputed between sources, revenue has missed the USD consensus before, and most of the recovery story has been public since the 2026-08-28 call. The two numbers differ in size, not sign: the sum adds many small leans that each only move p_up a little.

findings.finding: This name has paid for margin and EPS beats even with a headline revenue miss. Q2 2026 non-GAAP EPS was $0.37 against ~$0.32-0.33 and revenue $503.3M against $528.3M (-5%), and the stock closed +4.35%, then rose ~8% more on a broker upgrade. The six genuine earnings reactions (dividend row excluded) are -9.59, -13.14, +6.09, -3.12, +25.59, +4.35, with the last three of four up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin beat with revenue miss: +4.35% (Q2 2026). Revenue and SSS decline with a special dividend: +6.09% (Q3 2025). Q2 2025 and Q1 2025 SSS deterioration: -13.14% and -9.59%.
findings.why_not_priced: Reaction history, not a fact the market lacks. Its value is to say a USD revenue shortfall alone, which happened last time, is not a reason to expect a fall.
findings.independence: Q2 figures in the company release https://finviz.com/news/386551/chagee-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results; reaction from the sealed baseline

findings.finding: Management said on the 2026-08-28 call that July same-store sales were down low single digits y/y and that August was expected to turn positive, against a Q3 2025 comp of -27.8% (per-store monthly GMV RMB378,506) and Q2 2026's -16.1%. Q3 same-store GMV is therefore likely about -3% to +3%, the first non-double-digit decline in six quarters.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (+9.4pp sequential GC SSS improvement): +25.59%. Q2 2026 (SSS -16.1% but July improving): +4.35%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock rose ~12% over two sessions on it in August. What is not settled is September; the company has given no update since. A September that faded would show up as a cut in consensus revenue, but the USD consensus still implies about +14% y/y.
findings.independence: Macquarie's upgrade cites the same call statements (https://www.tikr.com/blog/chagee-stock-jumped-8-yesterday-macquarie-says-the-turnaround-is-real); Q3 2025 comp from https://finviz.com/news/240605/chagee-announces-third-quarter-2025-unaudited-financial-results. Same underlying document for both.

findings.finding: On 2026-11-12, after Q3 had closed, the board declared a US$1.95/ADS special dividend (about US$370M, roughly 38% of the US$967.9M cash at 2026-06-30) and a policy of annual dividends of at least 50% of net income from FY2027. A board that knew the Q3 numbers committed cash 18 days before reporting them.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement day closed +9.57% (the sealed baseline's 2026-11-12 row). The Q3 2025 special dividend came with results and the stock closed +6.09%.
findings.why_not_priced: The dividend itself is priced and now ex. What has been given back is the signal: the stock is below its pre-announcement level on a total-return basis (~$12.33 on 11-11 against $12.67 equivalent now). That reads as the market not crediting the board's confidence in the closed quarter.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers carries the same release (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/CHA/2611126184); same document, one finding.

findings.finding: The EPS bar of $0.33-0.36 (×~192m ADS-equivalent shares ×6.8 ≈ RMB430-470M non-GAAP NI) on the ~RMB3.66bn revenue consensus implies a non-GAAP net margin of about 12-13%. That compares with 14.3% in Q2 2026, 15.7% in Q3 2025 and Macquarie's call for 5.7pp of H2 operating-margin expansion. A Q2-level margin would give about $0.39-0.40.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 EPS beat of ~$0.04-0.05: +4.35% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: Aggregator consensus looks unrevised after Q2's margin beat. If the street had marked to Q2's margin, the EPS estimates would cluster near $0.38-0.40, not $0.33-0.36. Sources disagree on the EPS bar, so the size is capped.
findings.independence: Q2 margin of 14.3% in the company release (https://finviz.com/news/386551/chagee-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results); Q3 2025 15.7% (https://finviz.com/news/240605/chagee-announces-third-quarter-2025-unaudited-financial-results)

findings.finding: Own revenue model. GC stores (~7,240+) are about +2.5% on Q3 2025's 7,076 and GC same-store GMV runs about -3% to +3%, giving GC GMV of ~RMB7.6-7.9bn. Overseas GMV is ~RMB0.6bn (Q2 RMB504M, +114%). The revenue/GMV ratio is 44.6% as in Q2, up from 40.5% a year ago on the company-owned mix. That puts revenue at ~RMB3.6-3.85bn, ~US$530-566M at 6.8, against the US$537.7M consensus: in line to a slight beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue missed the USD consensus by ~5% in Q2 2026 and the stock still rose 4.35%; this line has not driven recent reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference, not a new number. Its main use is to show the consensus is not stretched relative to management's SSS commentary. The franchise fee shift to a GMV-share model could move the revenue/GMV ratio either way.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 base figures from https://finviz.com/news/240605/chagee-announces-third-quarter-2025-unaudited-financial-results; shares the SSS input with finding 4

findings.finding: The 2026 guide ('broadly flat' revenue and profit against RMB12.9bn / RMB1,909.9M, given 2026-03-31) is being run above. H1 revenue was RMB6.96bn (+3.5% y/y), and Q4 2025 revenue (RMB2,974.5M, SSS -25.5%) is the easiest comp in the company's history. The Q4-to-date commentary on the call is likely positive y/y same-store sales, helped by the 2026-10-12 nationwide buy-one-get-one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026, when the sequential SSS improvement and the outlook firmed: +25.59%. Q2 2025, when SSS deterioration was guided: -13.14%.
findings.why_not_priced: The street's FY2026 EPS of 1.31 already sits above a 'flat' profit guide. The open question is whether management turns qualitative 'stabilisation' into an explicit positive Q4 comp or a raised year. If the market expected that, the stock would not trade 20-30% below targets after a -7% total-return week.
findings.independence: Luckin said Q4 SSS improvement accelerated from the Q3 exit (snippet, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001767582/000110465926121665/tm2628441d1_ex99-1.htm release itself gives no Q4 trend); October BOGO volume from https://www.huxiu.com/article/4898151.html. Against it: October catering +0.7% (finding 12).

findings.finding: The delivery-platform subsidy war that Chagee sat out has receded. Meituan returned to profit in Q2 2026 as it cut subsidies, and a 36Kr piece dated 2026-11-18 says the war has receded and platforms are refocusing. The traffic drain that management blamed for Q3 2025's -27.8% SSS is gone in the quarter being reported.
findings.link: Shared channel: the delivery platforms (Meituan, Taobao Instant Commerce, JD) are the channel through which subsidised tea and coffee took pick-up traffic from Chagee's teahouses; the CEO said the company 'underestimated how much delivery-platform price competition would hurt offline sales' (2026-03-31 call).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2025 and Q3 2025, the subsidy-war quarters: -13.14% and +6.09% (the latter with a dividend).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, and it is the cause of finding 4 rather than an independent fact, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: 36Kr 2026-11-18, snippet_only (https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/4074837811844224); shares its cause with finding 4

findings.finding: Luckin (reported 2026-11-03) posted Q3 2026 self-operated SSS of -11.1%, worse than -5.3% in Q2, which it blamed on lapping 2025's elevated delivery subsidies. Delivery expenses fell 38.1% as orders shifted from delivery to pick-up. The category's subsidised base is unwinding, which hurts a subsidy beneficiary and helps a brand that was hurt by the subsidies.
findings.link: Same quarter, same China fresh-drink market and the same delivery-subsidy cycle, with opposite exposure: Luckin gained from 2025 subsidies, Chagee lost (Q3 2025 SSS -27.8%). Luckin revenue is RMB17.9bn a quarter, about 5x Chagee's.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no Chagee reaction history tied to Luckin prints found
findings.why_not_priced: Ambiguous. It can be read as weak category demand (negative) or as the subsidy unwind shifting traffic to pick-up brands like Chagee (positive). Net near zero.

findings.finding: Sector sentiment on Chinese tea chains is poor. Mixue fell more than 4% to a post-IPO low on 2026-11-23 and was down ~57% YTD by 2026-11-09. Chabaidao was suspended by the SFC on 2026-10-13 over alleged IPO manipulation, and Guming fell ~9% that day. Hong Kong investors are reported to be shunning mainland F&B stocks on consumption worries.
findings.link: Same category (premium and budget tea drinks in China); no shared quarter data; Mixue and Guming report half-yearly, so neither has reported Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: CHA fell ~1% net of dividend on the day Mixue made its low (2026-11-23).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced; it is the reason the stock slid into the print. It stays negative because a sector de-rating can cap the reaction to a good company print.
findings.independence: SCMP on HK investors shunning mainland F&B, snippet_only (https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360550/consumption-worries-persist-hong-kong-investors-shun-mainland-chinese-fb-stocks); Tea Baidao suspension and Guming fall (https://global.hk01.com/财经快讯/60399148/继蜜雪港连关6店-再有茶饮股-败走-茶百道遭证监勒令停牌)

findings.finding: China's October 2026 catering revenue rose only 0.7% y/y (September +2.1%), and above-threshold catering operators fell 2.9% (September +2.0%). That is a weak macro backdrop for the Q4-to-date commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no Chagee reaction history tied to NBS prints found
findings.why_not_priced: Public macro and a proxy. Chagee's own Q4 comp is -25.5%, so a weak overall category can still yield a positive Chagee comp. Sized small.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-12 Chagee ran an unlimited nationwide buy-one-get-one on all drinks through its own mini-program, with no delivery platforms, after brand ambassador Zheng Qinwen won the China Open. Stores reported 500 to 5,000+ pending cups against a normal capacity of 600-700 a day, and the offer was extended for nine days. Franchisees complained they bore about 5 yuan a cup of cost.
findings.why_not_priced: A Q4 event that only shows up in the Q4-to-date commentary. It likely inflates October traffic and member counts (members were 47.1M in Q2, down from 50.0M) but dilutes ticket size and franchisee economics. Not in the English-language wire.

findings.finding: US$120.5M of the US$150M buyback (authorised from 2026-06-01 for 12 months) remained as of 2026-08-24. An execution update, on top of the ~US$370M dividend, is likely in the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback was announced with Q1 2026 results, which closed +25.59%, alongside other drivers.
findings.why_not_priced: Known program; small incremental signal only.

outside_window.finding: The special dividend pays on or about 2026-12-04 and the 50%-payout annual policy starts with FY2027. The dividend is already ex, so it does not affect the window.

baseline_tension: No skew exists. The raw -21% run-up looks like heavy pre-print pessimism but is mostly the dividend; net of it the stock fell ~7% on sector sentiment. My mild positive lean therefore goes against a modest sector-driven drift, not against a strong market statement, and the poor sector tape is why p_up sits at 57 and not higher.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (verify the bar): EPS consensus is disputed ($0.33 / $0.34 / $0.36), so the EPS-margin finding was cut from +0.8 to +0.5 and p_up from 58 to 57; revenue bar has two agreeing sources and stands.

Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0; a proxy is small): the price-path finding, which partly rests on the drop having no company cause, was cut from +0.6 to +0.3. The macro catering finding was cut from -0.6 to -0.4 as unconfirmed macro-to-company transmission.
Rebuilding the reaction history from confirmed releases (lessons 'reaction history built from the wrong events') was already applied in the draft: abs_move 8% from the 6 genuine prints, not 9.57%.
Left standing: next-guide finding (+0.8), the SSS commentary, the dividend signal, the peers and the sector negative; no sign changes.
